environment.description: Kubernetes deployment running the WebSocket service behind an nginx ingress with default configuration. The gRPC backend (envoy sidecar) reflects metadata headers back in response without filtering. The frontend SPA renders notification HTML via innerHTML in the notification panel component. No CSP headers are configured on the ingress or application level. The frontend is served from the same origin as the WebSocket endpoint.

config.grpc_backend: envoy 1.28 sidecar with header passthrough enabled
config.frontend: React SPA using dangerouslySetInnerHTML for notification rendering
